text:
Hi Gaius team,
I lead knowledge management at the Warsaw office of an international law firm (about 120 lawyers in Poland). Our biggest problem is that 15 years of opinions, memos and contracts sit on SharePoint and in Outlook, and people can only find things by file name. Partners keep asking juniors to "find that memo we wrote for a similar client". We are open to a cloud solution as long as data stays in the EEA and is never used for training. Could you send a proposal I can share with our managing partner?
Best, Kate
